title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Drafting Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drafting Sheet
options.lineage: architectural construction drawings and plan sets
options.thesis: The agency site as a set of construction drawings: every claim dimensioned, every service a plan, the work shown as what was built from them.
options.viewport: A full-sheet title block header (EJAZ ALI / WEB DEVELOPMENT / SHEET A-01) over the claim dimensioned like a drawing, with the primary CTA stamped as a revision block.
options.risk: Goes cold or costume-y if the drawing grammar becomes fake CAD ornament; personality must ride on copy, not chrome.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The site as a Crouwel specimen: monumental letterforms built cell-by-cell on a visible construction grid, and the grid itself is the proof of craft.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: every section becomes a catalog cell on a visible white-and-blue grid; strongest challenger on both axes — studio-grade typographic confidence with total legibility.
options.risk: If the grid is set timidly it reads as a tidy template rather than a specimen; blue must lean navy to hold the white+navy steer.

options.label: Iridescent Edge
options.thesis: Cloud-white calm with slate ink and one spectral hairline: quiet premium, where honesty — observed vs. claimed — is the visible grammar.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on honesty-as-brand (placeholder labeling becomes a designed state), but loses on agency boldness: risks reading as soft SaaS and thin type undersells proof.
options.risk: So subtle it forgets the sell; the spectral fringe can tip decorative.

options.label: Safelight Bay
options.thesis: The project pipeline as a darkroom: compose, expose, develop, fix — a result emerging slowly because pulling it too early is a real loss.
options.case: Fuses poorly: amber-on-dark is one step from the glass-partition world being replaced, and photo chemistry is not this product's mechanism; only its station topology is worth stealing.
options.risk: Warm-monochrome fatigue; the metaphor outruns the product.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The friendly personal-brand template: light hero, rounded cards, logo strip, pill CTA — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every consultant site ships, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Safe, forgettable, and indistinguishable from the template you asked me never to ship.
